scope: Resident participant identity, independent character asset materialization, actor-private presentation and canonical pending rewards
changes: Durable residency lists all human characters and accounts; lookup supports every participant.
Human controllers require complete character states instead of stripped combat units.
One fenced transaction materializes each participant character, items, wallet, ledger, presence and outbox.
Participant snapshots use in-memory private character state; no database asset merge on presentation or checkpoint.
Private projection cache includes account and actor identity; foreign profiles, private logs and input receipts are excluded.
Shared preparation tableaux use the original room, preserving positions and scene identity across viewers.
Non-leader group rewards use the participant pending container; pendingRewards and the database-path reward move were removed.

verification.http: Two authenticated accounts, real local HTTP gateway, simulation-host and Worker; separate private state and commands; one room restored after close with a new owner epoch.

limitations: Shared-room tests provision the room before either character becomes resident. Active personal-to-dungeon owner transfer and join/leave product flows are not implemented by this change.
The rule kernel still uses a leader/party aggregate; separate UnitRuntime and permanent entity components remain unfinished.
Participant out-of-combat activities and complete multiplayer loot/quest interaction still need integration.
PGlite tests are not multi-connection PostgreSQL crash/failover tests.
No new browser playtest or native browser crash validation in this turn. Prior browser evidence retains its own version identifiers.
No measured capacity guarantee; existing large scene/model client bundles remain.
